detail.longDescription: Adam Julien has a rule about Fridays. "I never want to put anything live on a Friday and then be gone for the weekend," he says. He is a marketing coordinator at Panoramic Properties, with some programming experience and a background in game development. Panoramic Properties is a multifamily leasing company with about 50 buildings across 11 cities.
